scope: Persistent water clouds, independent atmosphere/cloud layers and particle redesign
preserved: Existing user world and rotation settings
changes: Conserved cloud water/ice and simplified upper-air transport
Condensation, re-evaporation, rain/snow thresholds and cloud solar shading
Cloud volume driven by material stock

Fine precipitation strokes, small angular grains, clay clumps, salt crystals and near-surface water jet

verification.layers: All four display combinations keep mass and cloud stock unchanged; hidden cloud simulation continues.
verification.persistence: Cloud stock, world settings, pause and layer choices restore.
verification.fallback: WebGL and CPU restore the cloud world.
mouseGameplay: Water planet heating and cloud/rain formation
Water, sand, clay and salt pouring

limitations: One representative water-cloud layer with prescribed winds and shared thermal column.
Methane haze is an optical proxy; methane cloud/rain and photochemistry are not simulated.

structure: Existing Workbench retained, larger scene, expandable environment, wide view and solar-system dialog
decisions: Material names, small colour dots and supply counts; no pictorial material catalog
Domain-warped water normals, hydraulic coastline reconstruction, two-level render mesh
Rounded falling grains merge into the continuous surface
Finite product collection and interplanetary use

build.warning: Babylon entry bundle remains above 500 kB

gpuCpu.inputs: 20 x 0.1 s, gases, clouds, mineral products and collection command

browser.mobileToolPanel: Opened and four tools present; no real-device multitouch automation

savedWorldRecovery.cause: Legacy cloud evaporation left negative Float32 roundoff near 1e-11; strict validation rejected it
savedWorldRecovery.fix: Bound each evaporating phase by its actual stock; accept and normalize only negative roundoff >= -1e-7 on input without altering original object

limits: Inactive planets use conservative CPU rules at 5 Hz; active and inactive numerical trajectories can differ
No ecology, meteorite or campaign implementation
Single-layer cloud and shared thermal-column approximations remain

searchable inventory and eight pinned quick materials
in-scene orbit overview and camera travel
